description: Host API v1 desktop pairing (schema/host-api/v1/README.md): the host-only HTTP routes the desktop Settings card uses to mint a pairing PIN and manage paired devices. Rows: POST /host-api/pin, GET /host-api/devices, DELETE /host-api/devices/:id. Served by extension/routes/host-api/http-routes.mjs, dispatched from extension/server.mjs after authenticate and the rate limiter. Every route needs the JWT AND the bus host proof header x-llmide-host-nonce (core/host-approval.mjs verifyBusHostProof), checked first: without it 403 HOST_PROOF_REQUIRED. Then, unless the core runs with LLMIDE_HOST_API_DEV=1 (never in production), 404 HOST_API_DISABLED. The PIN is six digits, one use, valid 10 minutes, one live PIN per user (a new one replaces the old); it is returned once and never logged. port is the bound port of the loopback v1 listener (3016 or the next free one); 503 HOST_API_UNAVAILABLE while it is not up. A device token is never returned. User-scoped: another user's device id answers revoked:false. Fixtures are transcribed from the handler (tests/host-api-routes.test.mjs); ids and timestamps are example values.

name.description: the client name given at pairing, at most 120 characters

lastSeenAt.description: ms since epoch, updated on each token sign-in

expiresAt.description: ms since epoch, 10 minutes after minting

revoked.description: false for an unknown or another user's device
